recentReviews.title: Trap for small investors — Hidden maintenance fees & penal interest
recentReviews.text: Terrible experience for retail investors. While competitors offer lifetime zero AMC, Zerodha debits ₹88.50 every quarter under the radar. If your trading balance goes even ₹1 into the negative, they start slapping 18% annual delayed payment penalty interest on you every single month. You can hold just a single stock, completely forget about the app, and wake up months later to find an inflated negative balance due to compounding penal charges. Customer support gives rigid script responses instead of fair solutions. If you are a small or long-term investor who doesn't trade daily, stay away. Go with brokers that don't penalize inactive accounts.

recentReviews.title: Kite app on iPad – Excellent charts, but the chart screen wastes the iPad's space
recentReviews.text:
As an active investor using kite on my iPad, I like the TradingView-powered charts, the indicators, and the quick Buy/Sell execution. The large screen is perfect for technical analysis, but the chart workflow doesn't take advantage of it.

The problem: When I'm analysing a stock on the chart screen, I can't move to the next stock directly. I have to go back, open my watchlist, tap the next stock, and then open its chart again. When screening 10-20 stocks in a session, this wastes time and breaks my analysis flow. Meanwhile, the iPad's wide landscape screen has plenty of unused space.

My request: Please add a collapsible watchlist panel on the right side of the chart screen in iPad landscape mode. One tap on any stock in the panel should load its chart instantly, keeping my timeframe, indicators, and layout. A swipe or arrow to jump to the next or previous stock in the watchlist would also help.

Why it matters: TradingView already offer this on tablets, and it's a standard feature for serious traders. It would save time and make kite iPad app a true trading workstation.

But the only issue because of which me and my friends are going to move to another broker is the absence of Bracket Orders for delivery trades. The need of the hour is to have a bracket order where we can specify entry, SL, Target and Qty in 1 single order valid for a year. The entry order gets triggered when the price reaches the specified price and only after the entry order is fulfilled, the SL/Trigger OCO order gets active. If other brokers can give it, why not the biggest broker in India???? Unless bracket order is implemented, we are moving to another broker. Will definitely return once this is made available.

recentReviews.title: SL Update Request
recentReviews.text:
Please make the SL update flow similar to Angel One.

Angel One provides a single input box, and the limit value is automatically updated based on the trigger value. In Zerodha, we currently have to update both the Limit Price and Trigger Price separately.

For quick intraday trades, this adds extra time and can cause missed entries. Please consider implementing the same single-input approach as Angel One, where the limit price is automatically adjusted when the trigger price is updated.

recentReviews.title: Serious order execution
recentReviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience with this broker. I have lost thousands of rupees due to what appears to be an issue with order execution.
Orders are getting executed even though the price shown on the chart and the market depth does not appear to have reached my placed order price. This is extremely concerning, especially when trading involves real money and even a small difference in execution can result in significant losses.
I have personally suffered thousands of rupees in losses because of these executions. When the chart and market depth show that the specified price was not reached, an order should not be executed at that price without a clear and verifiable explanation.
A trading platform must provide accurate, transparent, and reliable order execution. Traders cannot be expected to trust a broker when their orders appear to be executed at prices that are not reflected in the displayed market data.
I strongly recommend that the broker investigate these executions, provide complete order/exchange execution details, and explain why the orders were triggered despite the displayed price not reaching the specified level.

recentReviews.title: Request to Add Trailing Stop Loss and Trailing Target in Kite App
recentReviews.text:
Hi Zerodha Team,

It would be extremely helpful if Kite could support trailing stop loss and trailing target functionality directly within regular order placement. Currently, users have to manually modify orders, which becomes difficult during fast market movements.

Suggested features:
- Trailing Stop Loss based on points or percentage  
- Trailing Target (profit lock-in as price moves favorably)  
- Ability to set both SL and Target together with trailing option  
- Applicable for intraday as well as delivery orders  
- Optional toggle inside bracket / GTT / regular orders  

This feature would significantly improve risk management and reduce the need for constant monitoring, especially for active traders.

Many modern trading platforms already provide trailing exits, and having this in Kite would make order execution much more efficient.

Please consider adding this in a future update.

Zerodha trading app एक बेहतरीन और भरोसेमंद प्लेटफॉर्म है। इसका interface बहुत user-friendly है, जिससे नए और पुराने दोनों तरह के users आसानी से trading कर सकते हैं। App fast है, charts clear हैं और order place करना काफी simple है।

सबसे बड़ी खासियत इसकी कम brokerage है, जिससे trading cost काफी कम हो जाती है और profit पर ज्यादा असर नहीं पड़ता। Equity delivery पर zero brokerage और intraday में fixed charge होना इसे बाकी apps से अलग बनाता है।

इसके साथ ही Kite app की stability, real-time data और smooth performance trading experience को और बेहतर बनाती है। Overall, Zerodha एक safe, transparent और long-term trading ke liye best app है। ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I have been a Groww customer since past more than 5 years and I am very satisfied with Groww - wonderful interface, ease of use, prompt support. Recently I saw that Groww has introduced global investing through US stocks and US based ETFs. This is a good option for global diversification considering investment through mutual fund route is almost closed since early 2022.

It was my suggestion to Groww’s team to introduce UCITS ETF (ETFs which are not US based) since this would avoid high withholding tax on dividend as well as Estate tax imposed by US. Also, dividends of UCITS are reinvested automatically inside the Fund. Platforms such as IndMoney do offer UCITS ETF. Since Groww is a very progressive organisation and takes pride in always keeping its ears to the ground and giving customer satisfaction highest importance, I hope Groww team takes note of this suggestion.

recentReviews.title: One of the most pathetic experiences I have ever had with a financial platform.
recentReviews.text:
Groww looks impressive until you actually need help. The moment there is a serious issue involving your money, the so-called “customer support” becomes an endless cycle of useless automated replies, copy-pasted messages and absolutely zero accountability.

It is honestly frustrating to see a financial platform put so much effort into making the app look smooth while seemingly putting so little effort into actually helping customers when something goes wrong.

You don’t feel like a customer—you feel like a ticket number being passed around by a system that doesn’t care whether your problem gets resolved or not.

When money is involved, “please wait” and generic replies are NOT customer service.

The entire experience has been unbelievably frustrating, time-consuming and disappointing. If you expect quick resolution, proper communication and someone to actually take ownership of your issue, don’t expect much from Groww.

I seriously regret choosing this platform. A financial service should give customers confidence and peace of mind—not make them constantly worry about whether their issue will ever be resolved.

Groww needs a reality check. A good-looking app cannot compensate for terrible support and a frustrating customer experience.

I would not recommend Groww based on my experience. There are better alternatives where customers deserve to be treated like customers.

recentReviews.title: Not good enough.. If you want to lose your money, download this app.
recentReviews.text:
I am facing serious issues while trading on the Groww platform.

Whenever I place an order at the price currently displayed on the app, or set a specific price at which I want to buy or sell, my order is often not executed at the expected price or within the expected time.

I am also experiencing problems with stop-loss orders. Even after setting a specific stop-loss level, my position sometimes gets executed at a different price, resulting in a higher loss than I expected.

There also appears to be a delay in order execution. Even when the market reaches the price at which my order should be triggered, the order is not always executed immediately. This has caused me financial losses on multiple occasions.

I request you to investigate the following:

1. Why are my orders not being executed promptly when the market reaches my specified price?
2. Why are my stop-loss orders sometimes executed at a price different from the stop-loss level I set?
3. Is there any execution delay, slippage, liquidity issue, or other technical reason responsible for these differences?
4. Please provide the complete order execution details for the affected trades, including the order placement time, trigger time, execution time, requested price, and actual executed price.

I request a proper investigation and a clear explanation regarding these issues, as they are directly affecting my trades and causing financial losses.

Please resolve this issue at the earliest.

recentReviews.title: Upstox on iPad Excellent charts, but the chart screen wastes the iPad's space
recentReviews.text:
As an active investor using Upstox on my iPad, I like the TradingView-powered charts, the indicators, and the quick Buy/Sell execution. The large screen is perfect for technical analysis, but the chart workflow doesn't take advantage of it.

The problem: When I'm analysing a stock on the chart screen, I can't move to the next stock directly. I have to go back, open my watchlist, tap the next stock, and then open its chart again. When screening 10-20 stocks in a session, this wastes time and breaks my analysis flow. Meanwhile, the iPad's wide landscape screen has plenty of unused space.

My request: Please add a collapsible watchlist panel on the right side of the chart screen in iPad landscape mode. One tap on any stock in the panel should load its chart instantly, keeping my timeframe, indicators, and layout. A swipe or arrow to jump to the next or previous stock in the watchlist would also help.

Why it matters: TradingView and Zerodha Kite already offer this on tablets, and it's a standard feature for serious traders. It would save time and make Upstox's iPad app a true trading workstation.

recentReviews.title: Overcomplicated redesign is ruining a once-simple app
recentReviews.text:
As a long-time Upstox user, I am extremely disappointed with the direction this app is heading. I am not a daily day trader; I simply invest manage my portfolio, invest, and close the app until the next time. Upstox used to be great for this, but the recent design changes have turned a once-clean platform into a cluttered mess.
In the name of "upgrading," they have made basic navigation unnecessarily complicated. Finding standard services and essential portfolio details takes way too much effort now. The home page is crowded with irrelevant features that many of us never asked for:
 Unsolicited F&O & Strategy Tools: Pushing complex options trading strategies and trade ideas directly onto the homepage clutter is useless for long-term investors. Anyone who actively trades F&O already knows what tools they need; forcing it on everyone else just creates noise.
 Intrusive "Expert Advice" & Mutual Fund SIPs: Putting aggressive recommendations front and center makes the app feel cheap and chaotic. If someone wants to start a Mutual Fund SIP, they will intentionally navigate to the MF section—it doesn't need to take over the main screen.
Upstox needs to realize that adding more clutter isn't an upgrade—it's bad UX. Making the app hard to understand for simple, long-term investors will only drive customers away. If this bloated interface continues to prioritize pushed features over clean usability, I will consider closing my Demat account and shifting my portfolio to a simpler competitor.

recentReviews.title: Complaint Regarding Slow App Performance, Real-Time Data Delay and High Charges
recentReviews.text:
I am an active Upstox customer and would like to register a formal complaint regarding the poor performance of the Upstox trading platform.

The issues I am facing are:

1. The Upstox app loads very slowly, especially during market hours.
2. Real-time market data is not updating properly. Data freezes frequently and updates only after several seconds or sometimes minutes.
3. Charts and watchlists stop syncing regularly, making trading decisions difficult.
4. Order execution and price updates appear delayed compared to other broker platforms.
5. The platform performance becomes unreliable during volatile market conditions.
6. I also find the charges and fees comparatively high considering the quality of service being provided.

Due to these technical issues, I am unable to monitor the market accurately and there is a risk of financial loss. A trading platform must provide stable and real-time data without interruption.

recentReviews.title: From Upstox to Upstops
recentReviews.text:
I’ve been a user for the last 2 years, and the app has always been smooth and reliable. However, after the latest update, the overall experience has noticeably declined.

The new UI looks modern and clean, but performance has taken a hit. Navigation has become much slower than before, and portfolio values don’t refresh as quickly as they used to, which is frustrating during live market hours.

Opening charts now takes longer, affecting quick analysis and trading decisions. Another major issue is app continuity—when I minimize the app and reopen it, it rarely resumes where I left off. Instead, I often have to force close it from the background and launch it again, which becomes very inconvenient.

The redesign is visually appealing, but I hope the team prioritizes performance and stability in the next update. A fast and responsive experience is much more important for a trading app than cosmetic improvements.

Worst trading experience ever with [Angel One]I was trading in MCX and during a crucial moment, the app completely glitched. The price was frozen and not moving at all, because of which I was unable to exit my trade on time and suffered losses.

Even after providing proper proof including screenshots, trade details, and confirming that my internet/network was working perfectly fine, their support team kept blaming my network instead of accepting the technical issue from their side.

A trading app should be reliable during live market hours, especially in volatile segments like MCX. When the platform fails and users lose money because of it, the least expected is proper accountability and support. Very disappointing experience with both the app performance and customer service.

recentReviews.title: The Fraud Company
recentReviews.text:
Glitches and bugs at App’s end costed me a fortune.
When I have highlighted the same to the Team they assured me that it will be resolved and I will get the solution,
Now they have simply said “ Please note that we will be unable to provide any compensation for the loss in this case. Execution of trades is subject to market conditions and system validations. Additionally, the position could have been exited at the prevailing market price, which may have helped mitigate or avoid the losses incurred.”
As if I have done it deliberately and made losses.

They are even not taking responsibility for their fault and quoted me that the app was updated on 30th March for this issue, but when I checked the App updates there was no update released between 24th March till 15th April, hence they have clearly lied to the customer.
I request the users to stop using the app as you will loose your money due to Company’s greed and fraud.
I am still waiting for my refund.

recentReviews.title: Regression in Smart Stop-Loss Trailing Feature for Open Short Positions After Recent Update
recentReviews.text:
Dear FYERS Team,

Before the recent update, the Smart Stop-Loss trailing feature was available for open positions. However, after the latest update, this functionality appears to have been removed or is no longer working as expected.

I am specifically referring to open short positions in options trading, where the trailing stop-loss should move downward as the option premium decreases in favour of the short position.

Expected functionality:

* When I sell an option and the premium decreases, the trailing stop-loss should automatically move downward according to the configured trailing parameters.
* The stop-loss should never move upward during favourable price movements.
* If the option premium reverses, the last adjusted stop-loss should remain in place to protect the position.

Current issue:

After the recent update, the Smart Stop-Loss trailing functionality is no longer working for my open short positions. Consequently, I have to monitor the market continuously and manually trail my stop-loss, defeating the purpose of having an automated trailing feature.

I am also disappointed that FYERS customer support took approximately one hour to understand the issue. This raises concerns about the support team’s familiarity with this important trading functionality.

I request your technical team to:

1. Confirm whether this feature has been intentionally discontinued or whether this is a technical issue introduced by the latest update.
2. Restore the automatic downward trailing stop-loss functionality for open short positions.
3. Clarify whether any alternative order type or feature currently supports the same functionality.
4. Provide a clear timeline for resolution if the feature has been affected by a software update.

Automated stop-loss management is an important risk-management requirement for options sellers. Requiring users to trail stop-losses manually increases operational risk, especially during fast-moving markets.

Please escalate this issue to your technical team and provide a proper resolution

recentReviews.title: Scroll button
recentReviews.text:
Dear FYERS Team,

I am a regular FYERS user and I genuinely appreciate the platform you have built. The FYERS app has been improving continuously, and I particularly like its clean interface, charting experience, and the overall ease of using the platform for regular trading and analysis.

I would like to suggest a small but very useful feature improvement for the FYERS mobile app.

Request: TradingView-Like Scroll & Quick Chart Navigation

It would be extremely helpful if FYERS could introduce a scroll/navigation button on the mobile chart, similar to the functionality available in TradingView.

At present, while analyzing multiple stocks, if I want to move from one stock’s chart to another, I often have to go back and then open the next stock. This becomes inconvenient when analyzing a large number of stocks.

A quick navigation/scroll button directly on the chart would allow users to:

* Move easily between different stocks/charts.
* Navigate through charts without repeatedly pressing the back button.
* Quickly move backward and forward through historical price data.
* Analyze multiple stocks much faster and more efficiently.
* Have a smoother charting experience on the mobile app.

I understand that some similar chart navigation functionality is already available on the FYERS web platform. It would be great if the same convenience could be brought to the mobile app as well.

As a regular user, I believe this would be a small change with a significant improvement in the overall user experience, especially for traders who scan and analyze many stocks every day.

FYERS is already a platform I enjoy using, and I really appreciate the continuous improvements your team keeps bringing to the product. I hope the product team will consider this suggestion and introduce such a feature in one of the upcoming mobile app updates.

Thank you for listening to user feedback and continuously working to make FYERS better.

Best regards,
Hardik

recentReviews.title: Powerful tools, but needs a chart watchlist and dark mode in chart screen
recentReviews.text:
As an active investor using Dhan on my iPad, I appreciate the advanced tools and the fast execution. The big screen is great for technical analysis, but two missing features hurt the daily experience.

1. No watchlist on the chart screen: When I'm analysing a stock on the chart, I can't move to the next one directly. I have to go back, open my watchlist, tap the next stock, and open its chart again. When screening 10-20 stocks in a session, this wastes time and breaks my flow, while the iPad's wide landscape screen has plenty of unused space.

Request: Please add a collapsible watchlist panel on the right side of the chart in iPad landscape mode. One tap on any stock should load its chart instantly, keeping my timeframe, indicators, and layout.

2. No dark mode: I spend hours on charts, and the bright white interface strains my eyes, especially early morning and late evening. Most serious traders prefer dark themes for long sessions, and a proper dark mode also makes candles and indicators easier to read.

Request: Please add a dark mode (with an option to follow system settings) across the whole app, including charts, watchlists, and order screens.

Why it matters: Platforms like TradingView and Zerodha Kite already offer both features. Adding them would make Dhan far more comfortable for active traders and long chart sessions.

recentReviews.title: Critical Issues in Sell Order Functionality
recentReviews.text:
One of the most frustrating trading app experiences I’ve had.

When I click “Sell” from “Holdings,” the quantity should automatically be picked up from my actual holding quantity. Instead, it defaults to 1, forcing users to manually change it every time. This is a basic and potentially costly design flaw.

Also, by default, the order type is set to

“Market.” When I click on the “Market” input field, it should allow me to edit/select the order type and, if I choose “Limit,” immediately enable the Limit Price field for entering my desired price.

These are basic trading functionalities and common-sense UI requirements. Such a simple workflow should be seamless in any trading app.

If even these fundamental features are not designed properly, it seriously makes me question the quality and usability of the app. Please fix these basic issues instead of making users struggle with something that should be straightforward.

recentReviews.title: A REQUEST
recentReviews.text:
Dear Dhan Team,

I would like to appreciate the excellent work you’ve done with the Dhan DEX D3 platform. As an active F&O trader, I find it to be one of the best trading platforms available in India. The interface is clean, fast, and designed with traders in mind.

I have a few suggestions that I believe would make the platform even better.

1. Display P&L amount on Chart-based Target & Stop Loss

When placing a target and stop loss directly on the chart, the platform currently displays only the quantity. It would be extremely helpful if it also displayed the estimated profit or loss in monetary terms (₹), based on the target and stop-loss levels.

Seeing the actual amount at risk and the potential reward directly on the chart would improve decision-making and make trade management much more intuitive.

2. Reset Entry Price and P&L on Re-entry

This is the feature I would request the most.

Suppose I enter a contract at ₹200 and exit at ₹300. Later, I re-enter the same contract at ₹260. Instead of showing my fresh entry at ₹260, the chart continues to display an averaged or previous entry reference. This makes it difficult to judge the current trade accurately.

A bigger concern is the P&L display. For example, if I take a ₹10,000 loss on a contract, exit the position, and later find a fresh setup to re-enter the same contract, the platform still shows the previous ₹10,000 loss. Psychologically, this is distracting and can negatively influence trading decisions.

Every new position should be treated as a completely fresh trade. Once a position is closed, the next entry in the same contract should display:

* The new entry price only.
* Profit/Loss calculated only from the current open position.
* No carry-forward of the previous trade’s realized P&L on the active position display.

Traders can always view their overall realized P&L in the Positions, Orders, or Trade Book sections. However, the chart should reflect only the currently active trade, allowing traders to make unbiased decisions based on the present setup rather than previous outcomes.

I believe these enhancements would significantly improve the trading experience, especially for active intraday F&O traders.

Thank you for building such a powerful platform and for continuously improving it. I hope you will consider these suggestions in a future update.

Kind regards,

Areeb Khan

recentReviews.title: App interface related
recentReviews.text:
On the home page of the Dhan Mobile App, when I click on Portfolio Summary, in the section with options like All > Stocks > ETF > MF, the Stocks and ETF tabs show a very clean and consistent interface. For example, if I have invested in 4 stocks and 4 ETFs, all of them are visible on the screen without any need to scroll up or down. The Top-up option is also placed nicely at the bottom, which looks good.
However, in the Mutual Funds section, the interface looks very large, odd, and inconsistent. The Top-up option is placed at the top, which doesn’t feel right.
Request to the team:
You can also check this experience yourself — go to Portfolio Summary and swipe left to switch between tabs. It will feel strange to you as well.
I hope you will pay attention to these small details and work on improving the user experience.

recentReviews.title: Regression, Not Progression – Bring Back Trailing Stop-Loss!
recentReviews.text:
I have been a loyal user of Dhan primarily for its superior execution features, but the latest update is a massive step backward for serious traders. The removal of the Trailing Stop-Loss (TSL) feature is unacceptable and significantly increases risk exposure for intraday players.

The latest update to the Dhan app is a massive regression in risk management and user experience. By removing the Trailing Stop-Loss (TSL) feature and restricting SL placement to only below the entry price, Dhan has stripped away the most vital tools for any disciplined trader.

Previously, one of the best things about Dhan was the "set and forget" convenience. I could take a trade, set my trailing SL, and go about my other work without being glued to the screen. Now, the app forces me into constant monitoring. Because I can no longer trail my SL into profit, I have to watch every tick. If I buy at 100 and the price reaches 145, I am forced to manually exit or risk a reversal hitting my original SL below 100. It has turned trading into a high-stress chore.

This update also ruins profit potential. To avoid a winning trade turning into a loss, I am now forced to set small targets of 10–20 points. If I aim for a 50-point target and the market hits 45 before reversing, I lose everything because I couldn't lock in gains at 30 or 40. Often, the trade hits my "forced" small target and then rallies to 50 anyway, meaning I’m missing out on significant moves just to play it safe.
Dhan collects its brokerage fees regardless of whether a trader wins or loses. However, by removing features that allow us to lock in profits, the platform is actively making it harder for users to survive. A trading app should empower its users with better technology, not take away essential safeguards. This update feels like a move to benefit the house rather than the trader.
I am extremely disappointed. This ignores the reality of market volatility and the basic principles of scaling out of positions. 

I strongly urge the Dhan team to restore the Trailing Stop-Loss and the ability to set SL above the buy price immediately. Until then, this is a 1-star experience for any serious trader.

recentReviews.title: Very Log in Portfolio
recentReviews.text:
I am an active trader using the Dhan app, and overall the platform is good. However, I am facing a serious issue with the portfolio section.

Whenever I execute a BUY order, the portfolio updates very slowly and sometimes lags. This delay is affecting my trading decisions, especially during fast market movements.

The app also feels sluggish at times, which is not ideal for intraday trading where speed is very important.

I request the Dhan team to improve:
- Portfolio update speed (real-time reflection)
- App performance and responsiveness
- Reduce lag during order execution and tracking

This improvement will greatly help traders like me who depend on quick and accurate data.

Looking forward to a faster and smoother experience in future updates.
